## Introduction

This document is part of Practice Assignment 1 for ST2195 course.

The purpose of assignment is to practice using R abd R Markdown

## Printing integers from 1 to 10 

The following R code uses a for loop to print all integers between 1 and 10, including both 1 and 10 


```{r}
 for (i in 1:10){print(i)}
```
